[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Naomi Glasgow was born about 1805 in South Carolina. She was a daughter of [[Glasgow-1982|Wilson Crossier Glasgow]] and [[McCracken-3711|Mary McCracken]].

Mary's 1837 will divided her estate among seven children and Wilson's real-estate packet lists his widow Mary with Robert, Ruth, Naomi, Matilda, Hiram, Almina and Maria.<ref name="MaryWill">Newberry District, South Carolina, Will Book N, p. 1, will of Mary Glasgow, widow of Wilson Glasgow, dated 28 November 1837 and proved 22 October 1838; [https://web.archive.org/web/20101124215757id_/http://lifesweaving.com/Glasgow/Paper_WilsonGlasgowWife.html archived transcription].</ref><ref name="WilsonEstate">Newberry County, South Carolina, real-estate packet 1-13, estate of Wilson Glasgow; [https://genealogytrails.com/scar/newberry/realestate.html index], listing Mary, Robert, Ruth, Naomi, Matilda, Hiram, Almina and Maria.</ref> This closed seven-child group establishes both parent relationships.
